meta.title: An intent can only be recorded against an event, not another record type
gaps: The exact POST /user_intents request with item_type 'User' and item_uuid {{userUuid}} cannot be expressed because /user_intents is not an allowed request route and {{userUuid}} is not an available token.
The library case tests a made-up item type against {{tradeId}}, not a User record.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the user intents request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
